a3_iac_ci_collection_gap.description: infra/terraform/tests/test_ephemeral_staging.py was delivered in PR #1041 but originally was not collected by CI jobs on dev.
a3_iac_ci_collection_gap.resolution: Fully resolved by ODP-STAGING-IAC-CI-COLLECTION-001 (PR #1291). Added infra target to orchestrator job and pyproject.toml, pinned Terraform 1.9.8, added offline provider override and fail-closed harness, and introduced 24 collection and mutation tests in tests/tooling/test_staging_iac_ci_collection.py.

a5_receipt_generation_capability_gap.description: Historical inventory noted that PR #1041 did not carry generated staging receipt files for A5.
a5_receipt_generation_capability_gap.resolution: A5 states that API, Web, worker, scheduler, migration, one-shot, backup restore, and rollback rehearsal can all produce secret-free receipts from the same state machine. This capability requirement is verified by tests/ops/test_ephemeral_staging_lifecycle.py covering all 9 rehearsal stages (REHEARSAL_STAGE_NAMES) and secret_values_redacted=True, and locally demonstrated via verify_staging_lifecycle_receipts.py generating sample-secret-free-verify-receipt.json. As a code/workflow integration task, live staging deployment is not part of this task scope and no live cloud writes are inferred.

acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.criterion: 既有 Runtime Release staging 分支直接呼叫既有 staging lifecycle create/verify/hold/cleanup 且不新增 workflow 或 wrapper entrypoint
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml and tests/ops/test_deploy_workflow_contract.py delivered in PR #1041 (merge commit 462c8cd4ff25); verified that deploy-dev.yml invokes staging_lifecycle.py create/verify/hold/cleanup directly without second wrapper entrypoints; exact-head product CI success.
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.boundary: Verified workflow invocation contract and single entrypoint; no secondary deployment workflows introduced.

acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.criterion: release_id candidate SHA manifest digest 與 API Web worker scheduler exact image digests 綁在同一不可變 handoff 且不得 rebuild
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.evidence: Immutable release identity bundle verified by tests/ops/test_deploy_workflow_contract.py and tests/ops/test_ephemeral_staging_lifecycle.py (e.g. test_rerun_create_rejects_mismatched_candidate_sha_and_preserves_existing_state, test_rerun_create_rejects_mismatched_manifest_digest, test_immutable_release_identity_detects_worker_and_scheduler_image_mismatch); exact-head CI success.
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.boundary: Verified handoff contract and rebuild prohibition in contract tests; no live image rebuild attempted.

acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.criterion: release-scoped lifecycle outputs 成為 staging endpoint database bucket tenant 與 IAM 唯一 authority 靜態 environment vars 只提供長期 foundation inputs
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.evidence: REQUIRED_STAGING_OUTPUTS in product_ops/deployment/staging_lifecycle.py defines authoritative output mapping; verified by tests/ops/test_ephemeral_staging_lifecycle.py and infra/terraform/tests/test_ephemeral_staging.py (now collected in CI via PR #1291 ODP-STAGING-IAC-CI-COLLECTION-001); exact-head CI success.
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.boundary: Outputs authority contract verified; foundation inputs separated from release-scoped resources.

acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.criterion: staging smoke proof 不得 impersonate dev smoke operator 必須使用 release-scoped least-privilege identity
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.evidence: tests/ops/test_ephemeral_staging_lifecycle.py::EphemeralStagingVerificationAndHoldTests::test_verify_ephemeral_staging_dev_identity_rejection and test_live_executor_rejects_arbitrary_operator_identity enforce that dev smoke operator or arbitrary identities are rejected; exact-head CI success.
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.boundary: Negative identity enforcement verified; no live IAM credential assumed.

acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.criterion: API Web worker scheduler migration one-shot backup restore rollback rehearsal 均可由同一狀態機產生 secret-free receipts
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.evidence: REHEARSAL_STAGE_NAMES in staging_lifecycle.py implements all 9 stages (db_expand_migration, data_platform_snapshot, api_web_authenticated_smoke, worker_idempotency, scheduler_oneshot, backup_restore_drill, rollback_rehearsal, public_egress_denied_probe, external_providers_disabled_readback); verify_ephemeral_staging produces StagingLifecycleReceipt with secret_values_redacted=True; verified by 96 tests in test_ephemeral_staging_lifecycle.py and demonstrated offline via verify_staging_lifecycle_receipts.py generating sample-secret-free-verify-receipt.json; exact-head CI success.
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.boundary: Verified state machine receipt generation capability across all 9 rehearsal stages; does not assert executed live staging deployment.

acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.criterion: 第三方來源維持 disabled 且 public egress default-deny
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.evidence: infra/terraform/modules/ephemeral_staging/main.tf and tests/ops/test_ephemeral_staging_lifecycle.py & infra/terraform/tests/test_ephemeral_staging.py verify default-deny egress configuration and sources disabled flags in staging receipts; exact-head CI success.
acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.boundary: Verified IaC module and lifecycle metadata default-deny postures; external sources remain disabled.

acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.boundary: Cleanup label-matching and fail-closed policies verified via contract tests; no destructive live cloud cleanup executed.

acceptance_criteria_reconciliation.evidence: tests/ops/test_deploy_workflow_contract.py, tests/ops/test_workflow_expression_contexts.py, and tests/ops/test_ephemeral_staging_lifecycle.py execute negative tests asserting failure upon lifecycle bypass, static service names, or dev identity reuse; exact-head CI success.
